title: Suzuki–Miyaura (hetero-)aryl cross-coupling: recent findings and recommendations
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, 54,5746-5765
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS01108B, Tutorial Review
Jonas W. Meringdal, Dirk Menche
This tutorial review covers recent advances in palladium and nickel catalysed Suzuki–Miyaura couplings and offers recommendations on ligand, base, boron reagent and additive selection for a well-performing reaction with specific substrates.
